title: Generic positive-characteristic Artinian coefficient enlargement
statement: Let D:Type u and S:Type v be commutative local Artinian rings, p a prime natural number with S of characteristic p, and g:D to S a flat local homomorphism [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For every x in S and every padding universe w there are r>0 and a commutative local Artinian D-algebra D':Type(max u v w), a local structure map D to D', and a flat local map g':D' to S with g' composed with D to D' equal to g. The D-algebra D' is essentially smooth [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], and x^r belongs to g'(D').

source.place: Lemma 07FI, lemma-enlarge-solution-modulo, proof after introducing D (generic Artinian argument)

proof.text: Give S its D-algebra structure via g. The residue map makes the residue field of S an extension of that of D. Its characteristic is p because p is prime and maps to zero; injectivity of the residue field map gives characteristic p to the source residue field.

In the algebraic case, take a p-power making the residue of x separable. Apply the separable Artinian residue lift, obtaining D', g', and d whose residue equals that of x^(p^e). The maximal ideal of S is nilpotent. Choose a second p-power at least its nilpotence exponent and use sub_pow_char_pow to show (g'(d))^(p^f)=(x^(p^e))^(p^f). Thus x^(p^e p^f) lies in the image. The finite etale extension is smooth, hence essentially smooth by localization at units.

In the transcendental case, apply artinian_transcendental_polynomial_localization. Its local Artinian essentially smooth extension has a flat local evaluation map capturing x itself. Choose r=1. The two cases cover every residue, including zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_artinian_coefficient_enlargement
    (D : Type u) (S : Type v) [CommRing D] [CommRing S]
    [IsLocalRing D] [IsArtinianRing D] [IsLocalRing S] [IsArtinianRing S]
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP S p]
    (g : D →+* S) [IsLocalHom g] (hgflat : g.Flat) (x : S) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ), 0 < r ∧
      ∃ (D' : Type (max u v w)) (_ : CommRing D') (_ : Algebra D D') (g' : D' →+* S),
        IsLocalRing D' ∧ IsArtinianRing D' ∧
        IsLocalHom (algebraMap D D') ∧ IsLocalHom g' ∧
        EssentiallySmooth D D' ∧ g'.Flat ∧
        g'.comp (algebraMap D D') = g ∧ x ^ r ∈ Set.range g'
